note: One-at-a-time view only. Each multiple-choice question answers several laddered yes/no statements by a fixed cumulative rule: a choice records Yes for the statements in its `yes` list and No for every other statement in `statements`. The person sees what was recorded and can change any single answer. Scoring is unchanged: the engine still receives one explicit yes or no per statement. Groups and choices come from the team brief (Questionnaire design); ids checked against data/questions.json.
